LESSON: THANKFULNESS BY THE END OF THE SUB STRAND

Grade: Grade 3
Subject: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: By the end of the Sub strand, the ● Learners to read the story of Ananias and Sa
Topic 4.2: Thankfulness By the end of the Sub strand

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about Thankfulness By the end of the Sub strand. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. Explain the main ideas in Thankfulness By the end of the Sub strand
2. Practise Thankfulness By the end of the Sub strand at school and at home
3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Thankfulness By the end of the Sub strand

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. Explain the main ideas in Thankfulness By the end of the Sub strand
   In simple words: practise until you can explain the main ideas in Thankfulness By the end of the Sub strand. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

2. Practise Thankfulness By the end of the Sub strand at school and at home
   In simple words: practise until you can practise Thankfulness By the end of the Sub strand at school and at home. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Thankfulness By the end of the Sub strand
   In simple words: practise until you can give Kenyan examples connected to Thankfulness By the end of the Sub strand. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about Thankfulness By the end of the Sub strand using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Underline two new ideas about Thankfulness By the end of the Sub strand in the examples.
2. Explain Thankfulness By the end of the Sub strand to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Thankfulness By the end of the Sub strand.
4. Practise one skill from this lesson with a friend.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Thankfulness By the end of the Sub strand using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Thankfulness By the end of the Sub strand important for a Grade 3 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 7: CLASS ACTIVITY IDEAS

1. Recite Psalms 136:1 1. How do you thank Christian should be able to:
2. Say a simple, ‘Thank you’ prayer thank God for teachers and appreciate them all the to God your family, time

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. Explain the main ideas in Thankfulness By the end of the Sub strand
2. Practise Thankfulness By the end of the Sub strand at school and at home
3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Thankfulness By the end of the Sub strand

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.
